    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The agents are tabs; the map is their tab panel and says whose tools it shows
      - listitem: Every tool it can reach is a button that says its name, how it stands and how many calls it got; one without access says so and can't be opened
      - listitem: Opening a tool moves focus into its calls; going back returns it to the tool, and the map underneath is inert meanwhile
      - listitem: "Status is never color alone: running and failed are badges with words, unused tools say \"Not used yet\", the others \"No access\""
      - listitem: The counts in the bar on top are announced politely when they change; each keeps its width, and the blue running tag sits to their left so nothing shifts
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Every tool the agent can use has a blue line, the rest a gray dashed one; while a tool is being called, a deeper blue shimmer keeps running down its line, from the agent to the tool
      - listitem: "Switching agents keeps the tools and their gray lines in place: the blue runs in again over the lines from the agent, the card's content moves in from below, and tools gray out or come back softly"
      - listitem: The calls view slides in over the map as a white card, and the map grows to fit it
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything simply appears and the shimmer stays off
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Every tool card has a fixed size, so nothing moves when a call starts, finishes or fails
      - listitem: The map lays itself out from its own width; below 540px the tools sit in a grid under the agent and the lines give way
      - listitem: In the calls view, narrow puts the list above the call
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: Pass every tool of the run in tools, and per agent only the ones it may use – the rest gray out with a dashed line
      - listitem: "Keep calls oldest first and add new ones at the end; mark a replayed call with replay: true"
      - listitem: Up to ten tools fit the map comfortably; more still work but make it tall
      - listitem: "Line colors are solid, so lines that run together keep their color: --ui-tamc-used for access, --ui-tamc-off without, --ui-tamc-glint for the shimmer; how far a tool without access fades is --ui-tamc-dim"
